cell_kind: POOL -- a sealed five-sample greedy-first Solver pool on TRAIN Fold B. DESCRIPTIVE: no comparator, no gate, no admission.
claim_boundary: DESCRIPTIVE for the pool; 'nominated' at most for a rule selected on it. No system-level, superiority, generalisation, component-causal, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim.

contacts.scorer: CPU scorer jobs over derived copies only

decision_rule: OFFLINE SEALED-POOL READ (VER-1a; owner decision 257, 2026-10-10; claim ceiling 'descriptive' for the pool, 'nominated' for any rule selected on it; the pool cell claims NO benefit). One flight, one Perception visit and one grouped Solver visit per row of TRAIN Fold B: sample 0 greedy, samples 1-4 at temperature 0.7, all over the SAME state and evidence, committed in flight by saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 at min_support 3. THE READS, all from this one flight's sealed bytes, model-free: (1) CUSTODY (row accounting): 1,080 in, 1,080 out; every row's solver_group carries exactly 5 samples in custody (invariant I7g) with temperatures 0, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7 and the pinned seeds fragment_seed + seed_offset + index; the replay of the commit reproduces the sealed delivered text on every row; zero tool calls. (2) PER-SAMPLE scores: each custodied raw sample rendered to one outputs COPY (scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage render, five samples auto-detected) and scored ONCE with the registered scorer, both as sealed (unprojected) and through the lock's delivery rule v4g applied OFFLINE (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_apply.py --apply v4g; the in-flight cell delivers the unnormalised commit because the loader refuses a deliver_normaliser beside a grouped visit); sample 0 is read against the NX R1 / R6 lock column on the same rows as the byte-identity audit of the greedy first sample (llama.cpp greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch shapes, so equality is measured, not assumed). (3) SELECTION AND SUPPORT: the offline aggregation rules (scripts/analysis/slurp_sample_aggregation_offline_read.py: plurality-support commit at min_support 2 and 3 (s = 2 and 3-of-5 both read offline), greedy-sample-0 default, oracle best-of-5 as an UPPER BOUND) and the candidate-support read (scripts/analysis/slurp_candidate_support_read.py), together with the existing c3 verdict columns of the NX R1 / R6 flights on this roster (grouping: scripts/analysis/group_system_rollouts.py), from which the VER-1 verification rule is SELECTED. Bar: the 0.67 pp offline sealed-pool floor of the instrument note (section 2d). NOTHING IS LOCKED HERE: the pool read selects; a selected rule is flown, if at all, under its own registration (VER-1b) and confirmed on a roster it was not selected on.

output.note: ids, indices, scores, flags and hashes only; no utterance text, transcript, gold string or model output is printed or persisted

row_accounting_required: 1,080 in, 1,080 out; every row's solver_group carries exactly 5 samples in custody (I7g) with temperatures 0, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7 and seeds fragment_seed + 0 + index; the commit replay of saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 at min_support 3 / similarity 0.8 reproduces the sealed delivered answer for every row; zero native task-contract tool calls.

stages.1_render: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage render: one outputs COPY per Solver sample index (0..4), each row's solver_group.samples[index].parsed_answer rendered through the canonical analysis path; the sample count is detected from the sealed pool.
stages.2_score: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage score: each of the five copies scored ONCE through the registered scorer (never core.scoring_batch: every copy is a derived read).
stages.3_v4g: scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_apply.py --apply v4g over each custodied sample and the replayed commit (docs/results/2026-10-09-slurp-postprocessing-v4g-lock-v1.md): lock v2.2's delivery rule applied OFFLINE, because the in-flight cell delivers the unnormalised commit.
stages.4_pairs: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage pairs: per-row best / worst / delivered; the oracle best-of-5 ceiling stated as an UPPER BOUND, never as a result; sample 0 against the NX R1 / R6 lock column on these rows (greedy byte-identity audit).
stages.5_selection: scripts/analysis/slurp_sample_aggregation_offline_read.py and scripts/analysis/slurp_candidate_support_read.py over the sealed pool (docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-sample-aggregation-offline-read.md pattern), grouped with the existing c3 verdict columns by scripts/analysis/group_system_rollouts.py: the VER-1 rule is selected here at the 0.67 pp offline floor.

what_is_not_here: No comparator block, no margins block and no gate: VER-1a is a pool. The same-flight and cross-flight floors are CONTEXT, never this cell's bar.
